headline: Sensex jumps 1,000 points and Nifty tops 22,550 as IT and FMCG sectors lead a major relief rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: A relief rally snapped the Indian stock market's biggest weekly losing streak in 25 years
The IT sector saw a significant rally, with TCS shares jumping as a major contributor to the gains
Strong performance in the FMCG sector, which gained over 2%, provided additional support to the market
Broad-based buying was evident as all sectoral indices turned green during the trading session
whatHappening: BSE Sensex surged over 1,000 points while the Nifty50 climbed above the 22,550 mark
Persistent Systems secured a 94.04% stake in Nagarro following a successful takeover offer
Poonawalla Fincorp reported a fivefold surge in Q2 profit driven by rising income
The Indian Rupee recovered to 96.73 against the US dollar following intervention by the RBI
summary: Indian markets witnessed a massive relief rally on October 9, with the Sensex jumping over 1,000 points and Nifty reclaiming 22,550. The surge was led by IT and FMCG sectors, snapping a historic weekly losing streak. Key corporate developments included Persistent Systems' stake acquisition and Poonawalla Fincorp's strong Q2 results.
